snippet.title: The Bazaar: Introducing Karnok
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Bazaar!

Looking to play the game? Head over to https://playthebazaar.com/signup

Buy now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1617400/The_Bazaar/
Karnok DLC on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4418930/The_Bazaar__Karnok/

The Bazaar is an Intergalactic Marketplace full of dangers and wonder. Experience infinite replayability in this dynamic Hero Builder, where players battle commercial rivals for wealth and glory.
Join us on our channel for frequent updates!

Become a patron of The Bazaar! Click Subscribe and comment below to support. 

If you enjoyed the video, follow us on social media:

https://YouTube.com/PlayTheBazaar?sub_confirmation=1

https://discord.gg/playthebazaar
https://twitter.com/PlayTheBazaar 
https://www.reddit.com/r/PlayTheBazaar/
https://www.linkedin.com/company/tempo-storm

#playthebazaar #TheBazaar #TempoStorm #temporada3
